normalizationFormula: normalizedLoss = (loss - min)/(max-min); loss = IFN for IFN, -rawValue otherwise; zero-span scale = 1; no clipping
precision: Search vectors are rounded to four decimal places by legacy Chromosome.addObjectiveValue. No further rounding before comparisons or normalization.
representativePolicy: Existing minimum normalized Euclidean distance to the frozen calibration ideal; unchanged. These metrics describe the representative, not the whole set.
aggregationPolicy: Arithmetic means across the same calibration seeds; pairwise seed differences use matching seeds. Mean metrics summarize per-run representatives, not one synthetic decomposition.
tradeoffPolicy: Equal consideration of five metrics, no fixed weights or priority, no improvement-count voting; HV supplements set coverage.

hvDefinition.name: HV
hvDefinition.evaluationObject: Complete valid non-dominated solution set per run, not its representative
